name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A rulebook and toolkit that makes an AI coding assistant behave like a disciplined senior engineer — asking what you actually want before writing code, then planning, then building carefully.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small startup who wants AI-written code to stop needing so much cleanup review.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO installs it org-wide so every engineer's AI agent follows the same spec-first, test-driven process, cutting rework.
A fractional CTO consultancy standardizes on it across client engagements as part of the 'AI-assisted delivery' service they sell.
An agency selling AI-built MVPs uses it to keep junior-run agent sessions from producing unmaintainable spaghetti code.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed/paid support and custom workflow add-ons for enterprise teams (as the maintainers already hint at).
Sell a short paid course on adopting 'spec-first AI development' using this framework.

steal_this: It's a free methodology for developers, not really a product you resell as-is — the realistic weekend move is offering paid setup/onboarding for teams that want it installed and customized.
